**Issue #4511 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4511: Patch: the landing fan checks a few cards instead of all 800, and the collection, the stats grid and card prompts stop rebuilding every card face on each hover, scroll or keystroke
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a returning player opens the home page, the client picks the four cards fanned across it by first measuring the text of every card in the game, twice each, all at once. That freezes the page for a moment, just as it becomes usable. The same kind of waste happens elsewhere. In the Collection, resting the mouse on one card redraws every card on the screen. On the statistics page's card grid, each letter typed into the search redraws every card listed. In a game, an open card choice redraws all its options whenever anything on the board changes.

Once this is built, the home page measures only the few cards it is about to show, and those screens redraw only the cards that changed. Players see the same cards, dealt at the same odds, with less stutter. Phones gain the most.

## Why

- Each card face is worked out by the engine module. `faceModel` (`apps/web/src/cards/model.ts:42`) turns the card's definition into JSON, crosses into WebAssembly (`apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts:721`) and parses a JSON answer back. I timed it natively on the survey machine: a release build of `jackioh-wasm-core`'s `face` on 4 cores, run over the catalog's 800 non-token shipped cards, both faces each. 1,600 calls took 45 ms, 0.028 ms a call. The average call is 652 bytes and the average answer 2,402 bytes. In the browser, WebAssembly overhead and a `JSON.stringify` plus `JSON.parse` per call come on top of that, and a phone is several times slower again.
- **Landing fan.** A device with `ROTATION_MIN_GAMES` (10) finished games deals from `rotationPool` (`routes/landing.tsx:609-622`).
  - `fitting` (`routes/landingFan.ts:72-79`) runs `fitsTheFan` (`:61-67`) over all 800 shipped non-token cards. That is two `faceModel` calls per card (the normal face and the Radiant one), made before its cheap full-art check.
  - `dealLandingFan` then has `pickWeighted` (`:141-154`) weigh every card of each of the four drawn rarities through `featureWeight` (`:120-131`), at one more `faceModel` call per card.
  - All told, that is about 2,000 to 2,400 crossings in one synchronous task, a `useState` initializer or the effect that runs when the engine arrives, to show four cards. The `FITTING` and `WEIGHTS` caches last only for the page load, so every visit pays again.
- **Collection grid.**
  - Each tile calls `faceModel` inline (`collection/OwnedCards.tsx:111`).
  - The hover preview's state lives in `OwnedCards` (`useLookHover`, `:167`; `collection/LookHover.tsx:105-111`), so every time a preview opens or closes, every mounted tile re-renders. That is `POOL_FIRST_CARDS`, 48, or more.
  - Each tile then gets a fresh face object. That defeats `memo(CardFace)` (`cards/CardFace.tsx:798`, #3633), so the art, the text and the marks are all drawn again.
- **Stats grid.**
  - In grid view, `routes/stats.tsx:989` calls `faceModel` for every filtered card. The grid is not virtualized.
  - It sits inside `StatsPage`, which also holds the search box's state (`:293`, `:680`), so each keystroke rebuilds and redraws up to 800 faces.
  - `gridFaceOf` (`:149`) and the drill-down's tokens (`:1634`) do the same.
- **Card prompts.** `CardOption` (`game/Prompt.tsx:929-941`) calls `liveFace`/`faceModel` directly, and `pricedFace` wraps the result in yet another new object. So every re-render of `Game` while a picker is open redraws every option: a hovered target, an animation step, the opponent's choice hover.
- The repo already has the cure: `useLiveFace` (`game/faces.ts:74-97`, #3478, held by the test 'hovering the hand redraws no card's face' in `game/Board.render.test.tsx`) and the deck builder's `useMemo` around `faceModel` (`game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.tsx:203`). These four places never adopted it.

## Proposal

1. **Landing fan: stop checking the whole pool.**
   - For each drawn rarity, draw a card uniformly from that rarity and work out its fit and weight (one or two faces).
   - Accept the card with probability equal to its weight divided by the largest weight any card can have (`FEATURE_WEIGHT_PLAIN`, times `FULL_ART_WEIGHT_FACTOR` while full art is on). Otherwise draw again. A card that does not fit is never accepted.
   - This is rejection sampling: each card's chance stays exactly its weight over the summed weights of the fitting cards, as R374, R639, R704 and R1017002 say today.
   - After a bounded number of draws for one rarity, fall back to today's full filter. The hand then deals exactly what today's would when a rarity holds few or no fitting cards.
   - In `fitsTheFan`, run the `isFullArtCard` check before calling `faceModel`.
   - `rotateFan` uses the same sampler.
2. **One small hook for faces.** Add `useFaceModel(source)`, beside `useLiveFace` in `game/faces.ts` or in `cards/model.ts`. Memoize it on the definition, the Radiant flag, the face's other inputs and the locale, so a language switch still rebuilds every face (R711000). Use it in:
   - the collection tile;
   - a memoized stats grid card, in place of the inline `.map`;
   - `gridFaceOf`'s callers and the drill-down's;
   - `CardOption`, with the `pricedFace` wrap inside the memo.
3. **Behaviour-neutral.** No face, wording, odds or rule changes, so no ruling and no patch fragment.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/routes/landingFan.ts` and `apps/web/src/routes/landingFan.test.ts`; `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx` only if the call shape changes
- `apps/web/src/game/faces.ts` (or `apps/web/src/cards/model.ts`) for the hook
- `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx` and their tests
- SPEC §10.10 (the landing hand's R374, R639, R704; R1017002) is read, not changed

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test counts face crossings while dealing a returning player's fan from the shipped pool, through a spy on `faceModel` or on the module's `face`, as `Board.render.test.tsx` counts its own. The count stays under a small named bound (say 64). Today it is every shipped card's two faces and more.
- [ ] A test shows the new sampler gives each card of a fixture pool the same probability as a weighted draw over the fitting cards, either computed exactly or measured by frequency over a seeded source within a stated tolerance. A card that does not fit is never dealt.
- [ ] Every existing R374, R639, R704 and R1017002 test in `landingFan.test.ts` and `landing.test.tsx` keeps its claim. A test that pinned one card to one random stream may be re-pinned, never deleted or loosened.
- [ ] Collection: opening and closing the hover preview on one tile builds no face for any tile, and a scroll step builds faces only for the tiles it newly mounts.
- [ ] Stats grid: typing a letter into the search in grid view builds no face for a card that was already listed.
- [ ] Card prompt: a board re-render that leaves a picker's options unchanged (a hover, an animation step) builds no option's face.
- [ ] A language switch still rebuilds every face on each of these screens (R711000).
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on the touched files, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint pass, and `net/first-load.test.ts`'s budget is unchanged or lower.

## Size and risks

Medium: about six source files and their tests, all in `apps/web`, with no engine, server or spec change.

- The sampler must keep the odds exactly; the probability test is there for that.
- A rarity whose cards almost never fit could loop; the bounded fallback covers it.
- A memo keyed on too little would show a stale face after a setting or language change. Keying on the locale and the face's inputs, as `useLiveFace` does, covers that.
- The saving in the browser was not measured here, because the survey machine has no WebAssembly bindgen toolchain. The native figure above is the lower bound of the cost being removed.

---

Area: `client` (`suggestions.areas`).

Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45078885612)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Make the landing fan deal by rejection sampling (a few face crossings, not ~2,400) and make the Collection tile, stats grid/drill-down, and prompt `CardOption` build each card face once and reuse it across hover, scroll, keystroke, and board re-renders. Same cards, same odds (R374, R639, R704, R1017002), same faces; no ruling, no patch fragment.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/routes/landingFan.ts` | change | `fitsTheFan` full-art short-circuit; `FAN_SAMPLE_MAX_DRAWS`, `LANDING_DEAL_FACE_BUDGET`; new `sampleFittingCard`; `dealLandingFan`/`rotateFan` take `fullArtOn` and sample per rarity with filtered fallback |
| `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx` | change | Call sites pass raw `corePool()`/`shippedPool()` plus `fullArt`; `LandingFanCard` and the leaving ghost use `useFaceModel` |
| `apps/web/src/game/faces.ts` | change | New `useFaceModel(source: FaceSource): FaceModel` beside `useLiveFace` |
| `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.tsx` | change | `CollectionCardTile` uses `useFaceModel` instead of inline `faceModel` |
| `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` | change | New memo `StatsGridFace`/`StatsGridCard`; grid `:989`, `gridFaceOf` `:144`, drill-down tokens `:1634` render it |
| `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx` | change | `CardOption` builds its face (incl. `pricedFace`) in one `useMemo` |
| `apps/web/src/routes/landingFan.test.ts` | change | Sampler distribution test, face-budget test, re-pin changed streams |
| `apps/web/src/routes/landing.test.tsx` | change | Re-pin only if a stream moved; no loosening |
| `apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx` | change | Keystroke-builds-no-face and locale tests |
| `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.render.test.tsx` (or extend `CardGrid.test.tsx`) | new or change | Hover/scroll face-count tests |
| `apps/web/src/game/PromptCards.test.tsx` | change | Picker face-count and locale tests |

Do not touch: `crates/*`, `apps/edge`, `apps/server`, `spec/` (read §10.10 client rendering and rulings R374, R639, R704, R1017002 only), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `net/first-load.test.ts` budget.

## Steps

1. **`game/faces.ts`: add `useFaceModel`.** Import `faceModel`, `FaceSource`, `useLocale`, `useMemo` (all already in scope). Destructure `source` into `defId, def, name, type, radiant, liveCost, liveEmbiggenCost, fixedX, live, inPlay, chinese, tags`; `const locale = useLocale()`; keys `tagsKey = (tags ?? []).join("\n")`, `liveKey = JSON.stringify(live ?? null)`, `inPlayKey = JSON.stringify(inPlay ?? null)`. Return `useMemo(() => faceModel({defId, def, name, type, radiant, liveCost, liveEmbiggenCost, fixedX, live, inPlay, chinese, tags}), [def, defId, name, type, radiant, liveCost, liveEmbiggenCost, fixedX, liveKey, inPlayKey, chinese, tagsKey, locale])`. Never stringify `def` itself. Copy the dep-keying comment style of `useLiveFace` (`:65-72`).
2. **`routes/landingFan.ts`: reorder `fitsTheFan`.** Move `if (fullArtOn && isFullArtCard(def.id)) return true;` above the `[false, true].every(...)` so full-art cards cost zero crossings when full art is on. Keep the signature and R1017002 semantics.
3. **`routes/landingFan.ts`: add sampler constants and function.** Add `export const FAN_SAMPLE_MAX_DRAWS = 32;` (per-rarity draw cap) and `export const LANDING_DEAL_FACE_BUDGET = 64;` (deal face-call bound for tests). Add `export function sampleFittingCard(cards: readonly CardDef[], random: RandomSource, weigh: CardWeight, fullArtOn: boolean, maxWeight: number = FEATURE_WEIGHT_PLAIN * FULL_ART_WEIGHT_FACTOR): CardDef | undefined`: loop at most `FAN_SAMPLE_MAX_DRAWS` times, picking `cards[below(random, cards.length)]`; skip cards failing `fitsTheFan(def, fullArtOn)`; normalize `weigh(def)` exactly as `pickWeighted` does (non-finite or `<= 0` counts as 1); accept when `random() * maxWeight < weight` (a weight above `maxWeight` always accepts since `random() < 1`). After the loop, fall back to `pickWeighted(cards.filter((def) => fitsTheFan(def, fullArtOn)), random, weigh)`.
4. **`routes/landingFan.ts`: rewire `dealLandingFan`.** New signature `dealLandingFan(random, pool = corePool(), weigh = EVEN, fullArtOn = false)`. Keep rarity grouping, `shuffled` order, and `FAN_FACES` slicing; replace each rarity's `pickWeighted` with `sampleFittingCard(group, random, weigh, fullArtOn)`. Empty/undefined stays missing (sparse pools deal fewer).
5. **`routes/landingFan.ts`: rewire `rotateFan`.** New signature `rotateFan(hand, slot, random, pool = shippedPool(), weigh = featureWeight, fullArtOn = false)`. Replace `pickWeighted(candidates, random, weigh)` with `sampleFittingCard(candidates, random, weigh, fullArtOn)`; keep modulo slot, shown-set exclusion, Radiant preservation, and `undefined` passthrough.
6. **`routes/landing.tsx`: update four call sites.** Initial `useState` initializer and the `engineReady` effect: `dealLandingFan(random, fullPool ? shippedPool() : corePool(), fullPool ? favoringFullArt(featureWeight, fullArt) : favoringFullArt(EVEN, fullArt), fullArt)`. Rotation interval: `rotateFan(current, at, random, fullPool ? shippedPool() : corePool(), fullPool ? favoringFullArt(featureWeight, fullArt) : favoringFullArt(EVEN, fullArt), fullArt)`. In `LandingFanCard`, replace `faceModel({...})` with `useFaceModel({defId: def.id, def, radiant})`; same in `LandingFanSlot`'s leaving ghost. No other shape change.
7. **`collection/OwnedCards.tsx`: tile face.** In `CollectionCardTile`, replace the inline `faceModel({defId: def.id, def, radiant: false})` with `useFaceModel({defId: def.id, def, radiant: false})` (add `useLocale`-driven invalidation free via the hook). Leave `hover.trigger(def.id)` and all callbacks as-is: re-renders are cheap once the face object is identical and `memo(CardFace)` skips.
8. **`routes/stats.tsx`: memoized grid faces.** Add `const StatsGridFace = memo(function StatsGridFace({defId}: {defId: string})` that reads `def = catalog()[defId]`, returns null when missing, else the `div.stats-grid-face` + `CardFace` with `useFaceModel({defId, def, radiant: false})`. Replace the inline `:986-1004` map body with `<StatsGridFace defId={card.id}/>`, `gridFaceOf` with `(id) => <StatsGridFace defId={id}/>`, and the drill-down token face `:1634` likewise. `catalog()` returns the stable module catalog, so `def` identity survives keystrokes.
9. **`game/Prompt.tsx`: `CardOption` face memo.** Keep `useCardInfo`/`useFieldPower`/`useCopiedDef`/`isFlagged` reads; wrap the whole `drawn` computation plus `pricedFace` in one `useMemo` with deps `[info.def, info.name, props.item.card, fieldPower, copied, radiant, cost, flagged, props.item.price, props.item.defId, locale]` (reuse the existing `useLocale()` return as `locale`). `pricedFace`/`priceLine` stay pure helpers. Nothing else in the component changes.

## Tests

- `landingFan.test.ts`, new `it("the sampler deals each fitting card with its weighted share and never deals an unfitting one")`: fixture pool of ~6 defs with stub `weigh` (e.g. weights 1 and 3, `maxWeight` 4), stub `fitsTheFan`-false for one card; 20k seeded draws assert frequency within ±15% of exact share and zero appearances of the unfitting card. Exactness argument: uniform proposal plus `weight/maxWeight` acceptance gives `weight/sum(weights)`.
- `landingFan.test.ts`, new `it("dealing a returning player's fan costs at most LANDING_DEAL_FACE_BUDGET face calls")`: `vi.mock` `cards/model.ts` `faceModel` with a counter delegating to real (Board.render.test.tsx pattern), `dealLandingFan(seeded(n), shippedPool(), favoringFullArt(featureWeight, true), true)` for several seeds, assert count `<= LANDING_DEAL_FACE_BUDGET`. Run and keep today's R374/R639/R704/R1017002 claims; re-pin a stream only by updating the pinned id, never deleting.
- Collection (new `OwnedCards.render.test.tsx`, else extend `CardGrid.test.tsx`): spy the wasm `face` module as Board.render.test does; render `OwnedCards`, open/close hover via timers (`HOVER_DELAY_MS`) and assert zero new `card` calls; change the filter so only new ids mount and assert calls name only those ids; `await setLocale("zh-CN")` rerender asserts every mounted card rebuilt.
- `stats.test.tsx`: in grid view, record `card`-call defIds, type one search letter, assert no new call for still-listed ids; locale switch asserts rebuild. Follow the existing `R654 filters cards by search input` setup.
- `PromptCards.test.tsx`: render an open picker, spy `face`, rerender the same view with a hover/animation-only change, assert zero new calls; locale switch asserts rebuild; embiggen option still shows `priceLine`.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test <each touched file>`; `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`; eslint on touched files; `cargo jackioh spec check`; confirm `net/first-load.test.ts` budget unchanged (no new imports allowed).

## Done when

- [ ] Landing deal from the shipped pool costs at most the named budget; sampler probability test passes; unfitting never dealt; fallback deals today's hand for sparse rarities.
- [ ] All existing R374/R639/R704/R1017002 tests keep their claims (re-pinned at most).
- [ ] Hover open/close builds no Collection face; scroll/filter builds only newly mounted ones; keystroke builds no already-listed stats face; board-only re-render builds no option face; locale switch rebuilds every face on each screen.
- [ ] Touched web test files, typecheck, and eslint pass; `spec check` passes; first-load budget unchanged.

## Risks

- Seeded streams move (different draw order): expected; re-pin, never loosen. If a rarity's fitting cards are nearly unreachable, the `FAN_SAMPLE_MAX_DRAWS` fallback keeps the deal correct, just slower — that path is the old cost, bounded per rarity.
- `maxWeight` must cover the passed `weigh`; all production weighs peak at `FEATURE_WEIGHT_PLAIN * FULL_ART_WEIGHT_FACTOR`, and overweight custom weighs clamp to accept, so odds stay exact while the cap holds.
- `FITTING`/`WEIGHTS` module caches stay; the sampler bypasses `FITTING` on the fast path and uses it only via the fallback filter.
- `JSON.stringify` keys cover only small `live`/`inPlay` objects; `def` is keyed by reference from the stable module catalog, never stringified.

## Open questions

None. No person-only step: no secrets, dashboards, migrations, or forbidden paths are involved.
```
